claim: Four independently PN-eligible facet charts of one tetrahedron can agree on their literal C/M restrictions to all six shared edges.
policy: Use all 48 full validated port records from revision 19, without seeding restriction or gluing outputs. Choose one eligible record for each omitted vertex. Restriction is evaluation of each retained role function on the geometric shared edge, then on a vertex. Do not assign a PN two-M predicate to an edge or vertex: the certificate remains a certificate for the parent triangle.
positive_controls: four geometric facets cover all six edges and four vertices
face-edge-vertex restriction equals direct face-vertex restriction within each chart
full original port records remain available by digest
negative_controls: geometry-only agreement cannot certify role agreement
a changed role on one shared vertex must fail strict gluing
boundary: Only literal role-preserving restrictions are tested. Failure is not a refutation of context-indexed higher spans, nontrivial role adapters, native incidence objects, or the parent descent conjecture. Packaging records with native P does not by itself provide the missing compatibility cell.
stop_condition: Report strict gluing or its first missing typed edge cell, leaving general native incidence descent open.
